inte_shutter_cant: You can't end the day yet, there are important people in the queue
inte_bell_cant: You can't call the next customer right now
inte_bell_closed: You can't call the next customer, the Store is closed
inte_bell_dismiss: Dismiss the current customer and call the next one
inte_bell_cant_dismiss: You can't dismiss the current customer right now
inte_client_counter: There are {count} customers waiting in line.
inte_dimiss_cant: You can't dismiss the current customer right now
inte_dimiss_no_call: Dismiss the current customer without calling the next one
inte_sec_reported: The current customer has already been reported
inte_sec_cant: The current customer can't be reported
inte_sleep_cant_open: You can't sleep while the Store is open
ins_cig_intro: Counterfeit Hemingway Cigarettes are common on the station. Their value, as their quality, is significantly lower than genuine Hemingway cigarettes.
ins_general_discernible_note: The differences should be obvious at a glance.
ins_cig_lettering_info: Spelling errors, misaligned text or uneven print quality on the pack, differences in color, font or missing lettering all indicate fraud.
ins_cig_seal_info: Hemingway Cigarettes are never sold without a security seal. If the security seal is missing or broken, the cigarette is a counterfeit.
ins_stamp_intro: As part of the Republic's very generous welfare initiative, Food Stamps are routinely distributed among the most needy in the Lower Levels. These can be used to buy essential items in stores backed by the Republic. Be warned, however: counterfeit Food Stamps are not unusual in the Lower Levels.
ins_stamp_lettering_intro: Look for spelling errors, obvious misaligned text. Differences in color, font or missing lettering are also common in forgeries.
ins_stamp_seal_intro: If the Food Stamp has a printed value of 160 Credits or higher, it will have a security seal. Food Stamps under 160 Credits will not have a security seal.
ins_stamp_value_intro:
Food Stamps are ONLY issued with values of:
40 Credits, 80 Credits,
120 Credits, 160 Credits,
200 Credits, 240 Credits
ins_stamp_chip_intro: All Food Stamps contain a chip. If the chip is missing or damaged, the Food Stamp is unusable, even if it is genuine.
ins_inj_intro: A high-precision immuno-regulator developed to temporarily suppress the effects associated with the deadly auto-immune condition Sentinel Collapse.
ins_inj_label_intro:
Possible Errors:
 -Spelling
 -Missing Company Name
 -Missing Product Name
 -Significant Font Discrepancy
ins_inj_serial_number_intro: All Immunivax Injector MUST have a valid seven-digit serial number. The first three digits are the batch numbers. Valid range: 1250000-4559999.
ins_inj_body_intro: If any damaged such as clearly visible cracks can be seen on the injector. It is considered to be Unusable
rev_card_proverb: "Power exists to uplift, not to oppress."
deed_body:
This document certifies the holder as the lawful owner of the commercial property located at:

Lower Level, Sector 14

This deed hereby grants full ownership rights of the aforementioned property to the holder, effective immediately upon settlement of the debt as outlined in the Deeds of Agreement and upon full payment of the agreed purchase price.

The ownership of the property includes the following rights:

Right to Operation and Management - Full control over, and assumed responsibility for, daily operations and activities.
Right to Renovation or Alteration - Subject to applicable sector zoning laws and regulations.
Right to Sell or Transfer - Subject to approval by the station’s governing authority and in accordance with all applicable rules and regulations.
lease_body:
SECTION 1: PARTIES
The Landlord: ("Landlord"),
The Shopkeeper: ("Tenant").

SECTION 2: PREMISES
The Landlord leases to the Tenant for the operation of a commercial business, subject to the terms and conditions outlined herein.

SECTION 3: RENTAL TERMS
Rent Amount: Undetermined        
Payment Schedule: Every Seven Days

SECTION 4: FAILURE TO PAY RENT
If Rent is not paid by the due date, the Tenant shall be granted a one-time grace period during the term of this Agreement. Any missed Rent will be added to the following week’s Rent. Failure to pay the full adjusted amount by the following due date will constitute a breach of this Agreement.

Eviction Clause: If the Tenant fails to pay Rent or the adjusted Rent as outlined, the Landlord reserves the right to terminate this agreement, and initiate eviction procedures as per Station Ordinances.

SECTION 5: RENT ADJUSTMENT
Rent Increase: The Landlord retains the right to adjust the Rent by up to 5% of the current Rent amount for the subsequent week.
lottery_intro: The Lower Levels Lottery is finally back! Your fortune starts with a single ticket. Grab yours now!
lottery_how_intro: The Lottery winning numbers are drawn every Saturday morning. Winning Numbers will be announced in the newspaper.
lottery_system_intro: 6 unique numbers from 1-49 will be drawn. You win prizes based on how many of your numbers match the six numbers drawn.
lottery_prizes_intro: 6 unique numbers from 1-49 will be drawn. You win prizes based on how many of your numbers match the six numbers drawn.
intel_mentor_note_basic_trading_body:
1. Drag the item to the Negotiation Counter and the Negotiation Interface will appear.
 2. A button will appear if you are able to buy or sell the item.

 Clients only have a limited budget to spend at your Store.

You will automatically sell your items with a retail markup.
intel_mentor_note_food_body:
Food is the most traded commodity on the station.
 Keeping Food in stock is highly recommended, as Food and water prices can rise sharply during shortages. Everyone has to eat.
intel_mentor_note_afterhours_body:
After closing the Store for the day, you should have time to visit one of the various locations around the Sector.
 You can always return to the Dumping Grounds to scavenge. You won't be able to bring much back to the Store without a backpack.
 You should also bring a bandage to patch yourself up in case you get wounded while scavenging. If you are badly hurt, you won't be able to go out for a few days.
intel_mentor_note_wholesale_body:
Sometimes sellers offer a discount if you buy all of their items. (This is called buying "Wholesale".)

 You can still inspect each item in the offer individually.
intel_mentor_note_contraband_body:
Contraband includes any item that is considered illegal by the Republic. The possession or sale of Contraband carries a high risk... and a higher profit margin.
 There are 4 tiers of Contraband:
Low Level (+{0}% Profit Margin): While technically illegal, they are generally ignored by Security unless they are out to get you.
 Mid Level (+{1}% Profit Margin): If found during Inspection, this item will be seized.
 High Level (+{2}% Profit Margin): If found during Inspection, this item will be seized and you will receive a fine.
 Critical Level (+{3}% Profit Margin): If found during Inspection, the Store will be shut down permanently and you will be immediately arrested.
Additionally, you will lose Reputation with Security if any Contraband is found.
intel_mentor_note_stolen_body:
It is illegal to trade in [Stolen] items. Each stolen item has Heat value, the higher the Heat, the more likely Security will recognize it on inspection. Sellers will offer a discount based on the Heat value.
 Heat slowly decreases over time.
intel_mentor_note_inspection_body:
Station Security will conduct random inspections for Contraband. Your Reputation with Security will affect the severity of your punishment when Contraband is found. Events can affect how often the Store is inspected.

Additionally, different Officers will conduct inspections differently. Some may be open to a bribe; others may not search every container.
intel_mentor_note_appraisal_body:
Some valuable items marked as [Appraisal Item] have complex price structures. Customers will visit the Store and use your appraisal service to determine the value of their item.

 You will receive a base service fee for the appraisal, plus a bonus based on the precision of the appraisal.
You will be able to pass appraisal examinations and receive a certification that will improve your base service fee and unlock new item types to appraise.
intel_mentor_note_events_body:
Certain events will effect the market price of items, temporarily causing them to rise, or fall. The Newspaper will list most ongoing events.
Some insiders can sell you tips for events before they happen.
intel_mentor_note_barter_body:
Sometimes customers will arrive and offer to exchange items, rather than Credits.
 Barter offers cannot be negotiated unlike regular buy and sell offers.
 They are also not impacted by ongoing events.
intel_mentor_note_display_case_body: On the left side of the Shutter Door, you'll find the Display Case, one of the key features of your Store. Depending on the type of items you place inside, you can attract one client per day looking to buy that type of item. For example, if you put many [Food] items and one low-value [Medical] item, a food-buying client will visit the store the next day. The total value of the items stored will impact the social class of the attracted client. Upgrading your Display Case will allow you to attract more clients. Make sure to stock the Display Case before opening the Store each day. Do not keep Contraband inside the Display Case or you will be arrested.
intel_mentor_note_upgrades_body:
As the days go by, you will meet various persons of interest who will offer to upgrade your Store for a price.
 These upgrades can be useful, but you must be careful when managing your cash flow and keep an eye out for the next rent payment.
intel_mentor_note_visual_inspection_body: Certain items will be marked as inspectable using a Magnifying Glass. Use the Magnifying Glass on an inspectable item to open the Inspection Tray. If there's an issue with the item, you can select a reason at the bottom of the Inspection Tray UI to confront the client about it. If the item is counterfeit, one issue is enough to confront the client. If you are right, the client will adjust the price. If you are wrong, you will lose Reputation and the client may take their business elsewhere.
intel_mentor_note_stamp_body:
Food Stamps are part of a social program to help eligible Lower Level citizens and prevent civil unrest.
 Food Stamps can be redeemed and are used at the Commissary to buy Food.
 Food Stamps can carry various values. Since they can only be used to buy Food, they are often traded at a lower value for Credits.
 The Stamps are sometimes forged and sold to unsuspecting victims, who only find out after failing to redeem the Stamp.
intel_mentor_note_commissary_body:
The Commissary is run by the Republic. The prices of all items sold here are fixed, and unaffected by the market.

 Nevertheless, while the price of goods is fixed, the availability of items is very much affected by the market.
 Only Food Stamps can be used to purchase goods at the Commissary.

<u>Visit the Commissary after closing the Store to purchase goods.</u>
intel_mentor_note_labels_body:
Certain items can be relabeled. For example, you can label a counterfeit box of cigarettes as genuine to raise its price.

 Beware — most workers, Security Officers, and Lower Level citizens are familiar with common item fraud. Scam attempts will fail and result in a penalty to your Reputation.
 While Scavengers are also familiar with item fraud, they often don't carry the equipment required to test for authenticity, if any is needed.
 Tourists and Upper Level citizens, however, are generally less aware.
 But sooner or later, people will find out.
intel_mentor_note_scd_body:
I am sorry to hear that you have SCD... It's a serious health condition that you will live with for the rest of your life.
 You will need to take regular Immunivax shots or your health will deteriorate and suffer permanent damage. You can afford to miss a few days at the start, but the damage adds up over time.
intel_rev_codeword_body:
The following codewords will be used in Marketplace Requests:
Upcoming Operation, Birthday Party
 Oxymore Injector, Refreshment
 Raid, Gathering
Safehouse, Garden
 Security Access Card, Housewarming Gift
 Extraction, Vacation
Compromised, Decrepit
 High Priority Emergency, Last-Minute
intel_rev_codeword_short_desc: An inconspicuous slip of paper with a hastily written key for the code used by revolutionaries.
book_ribwich_base_value_body: All Ribwichs start at 150 Credits. Different conditions can affect its price.
book_ribwich_intro: A limited edition sandwich from Davre. Now discontinued, it's price now steadly increasing due to people still eating it.
book_ribwich_section1_body:
If the plastic packaging is missing, torn open or counterfeit, the final value will always be 40 credits regardless of anything else. 
Ribwichs can't have a final value lower than 40 credits, regardless of any condition.
book_ribwich_section2_body: All Ribwichs will have their production date displayed on the packaging. The Ribwich were only ever produced on the following runs:
book_ribwich_section2_example:
1st Production Run: January 425 - December 429
2nd Production Run: January 432 - December 438
book_ribwich_section2_body4: The Ribwich produced on the very first month (01/425) and the very last month (12/438) are worth +50 Credits for historical reasons.
book_ribwich_section2_body3: The first production run Ribwich were made using better material and are worth +80 Credits
book_ribwich_section2_body2: If the production date is missing, invalid or outside the range, then it is counterfeit.
book_ribwich_section3_body: Davre used a number of facility to produce and package the Ribwich, some are known to have higher or lower quality control standard which can affect the Ribwich shelf life.
book_ribwich_section3_example:
High Quality Packing Facility: 01, 02, 05, 08, 21, 34
Low Quality Packing Facility: 07, 15, 18, 26, 31
book_ribwich_section3_body2: There's 35 total packing facilities that were used. If the packing facility number is missing or invalid, then the Ribwich is counterfeit.
book_ribwich_section3_body3: Ribwich from the high quality packing facility are worth +50 Credits
book_ribwich_section3_body4: Ribwich from the low quality packing facility are worth -50 Credits
book_ribwich_section3_body5: Example of a genuine Ribwich from the second production run:
book_ribwich_section4_body: Ribwich with sesame bun and extra pickles were also released along the normal Ribwich and was marketed as Deluxe Edition
book_ribwich_section4_example: The Deluxe edition ribwich must have both the sesame bun and extra pickles. if only one is present then it is counterfeit.
book_ribwich_section4_body2: Valid deluxe edition are worth +300 Credits
book_ribwich_section5_body: In rare instances, it has been reported that Davre’s packing machine malfunctioned and produced Ribwiches with two meat patties. These Ribwiches are typically removed and destroyed by the quality control team, making double-patty Ribwiches extremely rare.
book_ribwich_section5_body2: Valid double patty Ribwich are worth +800 Credits
book_ribwich_section6_body: All Ribwich must have the Davre Logo, if missing or incorrect, then it is counterfeit.
book_ribwich_section7_body: All 2nd production ribwich will have a Ribwich sticker, if missing or incorrect, then it is counterfeit. 1st production will not have the Ribwich sticker.
book_fuel_p1_body:
Plasma Cartridges are the standard fuel of the the Pulse Plasma Drive, a common installation on small-to-medium spacecraft.
A result of high demand and light regulation, Plasma Cartridges are manufactured in sweatshops and industrial laboratories both. Where a Plasma Cartridge is made will affect its quality.

This guide will provide everything you need to know to appraise the value of any Plasma Cartridge.
book_fuel_p1_body3:
There are four common manufacturers on the Station:

	- Wild's Rides ("WLD"),
	- Republic Naval Requisition ("RNR"),
	- ZhongHua Shipbuilding ("ZHS"),
	- Ignition Lab ("IGN")
book_fuel_p1_body4: Regardless of manufacturer or current condition, Plasma Cartridges have a base value of 300 Credits, and a minimum value of 90 Credits.
book_fuel_p2_body: The value of a Plasma Cartridge is determined by its condition. The condition is the total sum of the cartridges attributes.
book_fuel_p4_body:
The color of the plasma is the biggest indicator of quality.
Any color not Standard or High-Grade is regarded as Low-Grade.
book_fuel_p5_m1_desc:
WLD Plasma Cartridges are manufactured in the Lower Levels, and are highly variable in quality.
Possible Cartridge Condition: Any
Possible Color: Low-Grade, Standard
Seal: Always
book_fuel_p5_m2_desc:
ZHS Plasma Cartidges have a more reasonable price point, but without compromising on quality.

Possible Cartridge Condition: None or Reinforced
Possible Color: Standard
Seal: Always
book_fuel_p6_m2_desc:
A specialized R&D lab, IGN Plasma Cartridges are manufactured to the highest possible grade.
Possible Cartridge Condition: None
Possible Color:  High-Grade
Seal: Always
book_fuel_p6_m1_desc:
Funded by the Republic itself, RNR Plasma Cartridges are typically retrieved and recycled.

Possible Cartridge Condition: Any, Except Cracks
Possible Color: Standard
Seal: Always
book_water_s1_body: The quality of water is determined by its purity:
book_water_s1_caution: Consume if necessary, prolonged use not advised
book_water_s1_unsafe: Unsafe and risky for human consumption
book_water_s1_toxic: Warning: Highly Toxic, Do Not Consume
book_water_s2_body: Water sold on the station may not be labeled correctly, whether intentionally or not. Always verify water quality before purchase and consumption.
book_water_s2_body2: A Water Testing Strip is a cheap and easy way to test the purity of water.
book_water_s3_body:
Water on the station can contains multiple types of contaminants. Each method of purification is effective against only certain types of contaminants.

If repeated attempts do not improve the water's purity, your chosen purification method cannot remove the remaining contaminants in the water.
book_water_s3_body2: Water Purification Tablets reduce chemical contaminants first, then eliminate microbial contaminants with what remains. One tablet is enough for a large bottle of Rustwater; dirtier water may require several.
book_water_s3_body3:
Water Filter: When installed inside a pitcher, it filters water as it is poured in.
It removes impurities, microplastics, and organic waste. Filters have limited durability.
book_water_s3_note: Using Purification Tablets and a Water Filter together should bring most water up to Basewater, or even High-Quality Water, depending on the initial purity. Heavily contaminated water may require several tablets.
book_water_s3_note2: To reach Pure Water, a dedicated Water Purifier with properly installed Modules is required.
book_water_s3_note3: Purifying Gutterflow using basic purification methods is not recommended, as it rapidly degrades Water Filter durability.
book_water_s4_body1: Hard to procure even for those living on the Upper Levels. Incredibly expensive and used primarily in sensitive environments like Hospitals and Laboratories. In Upper Levels societies, offering pure water to guests demonstrates high social status.
book_water_s4_body2: The standard on the Upper Levels. Safe for drinking, cooking, and most household uses, it is more accessible but still costly.
book_water_s4_body3: The standard for Lower Levels. Adequate for short-term use, but prolonged exposure can contribute to development of chronic disease.
book_water_s4_body4: Indistinguishable by eye from other higher quality water, yet unsafe to drink unfiltered. Ghostwater is most commonly used in farming and industry. The sale of mislabeled Ghostwater is a common scam in the Lower Levels.
book_water_s4_body5: Unsuitable for farming, and dangerous to drink. Can be identified visually.
book_water_s4_body6: Heavily contaminated and toxic. Seek immediate medical attention if consumed. Can be visually identified.
book_water_s5_a1_body: Rustwater and Gutterflow are harder to mislabel since they are visually distinguishable from other types of water by color.
book_water_s5_a2_body: The sale of Ghostwater mislabeled as Basewater is a common scam in the Lower Levels. Selling large volume of mislabeled Ghostwater is a crime.
book_water_s5_a3_body:
Scavengers are typically too poor to carry a Water Testing Kit.
Some Citizens of the Lower Levels and Scavengers will not buy Pure Water.
Tourists and Upper Level Citizens are often too oblivious to test the purity of the water they buy.
Customers requesting large amounts of water will typically carry a Water Testing Kit.
book_farm_s1_body:
'1. Insert a filled water container with Ghostwater or Basewater.
2. Add some Minerals to make sure there''s enough nutrient.
3. Insert power source and seed.
4. After a day or two, the farm should be ready for harvest.
book_farm_s1_note: Add water and replace the energy cell as needed to ensure that hydroponic keep running!
book_farm_s2_body:
Start learning hydroponic by farming Nutrifruit. It is genetically modified to be an easy to farm crop.

Make sure to keep enough clean water and add a nutriment tablet to the water when the yield decrease.
book_farm_s3_water_body: Certain contaminants can harm the plant's growth. Make sure to use water with a low concentration of contaminants, unless you farming a crop with particular needs. (NOTE: Minerals are NOT contaminants.)
book_farm_s3_nutrient_body: Plants require Minerals to grow. Too little or too much can have negative impact on the yield. Each plant has specific nutrient concentration tolerance. Usually, it's better to have too much Minerals than not enough.
book_farm_s3_analyser_body: Can be used on a seed to check its needs and their current health.
book_chem_p1_s1_body: Can be unpack to obtain various essential chemicals
book_chem_p1_s2_body: Use it on liquid container or chemical product to see their composition
book_chem_p1_s3_body: Can be upgraded to improve extraction yield
book_chem_p1_s4_body: Can be upgraded to improve max temperature, temperature control and heating speed.
book_chem_p1_s5_body: Work overnight to remove certain liquid such as water and alcohol. Use normal modules
book_chem_p1_s6_body: Can be upgraded to reduce the amount of impurity introduced
book_chem_p1_module: Unlike other machines, most of the machine related to chemistry can only be upgraded with the special Chemical Equipment Module.
book_chem_p2_s1_body:
- Attach a liquid container to the Blender
- Add a few Dream Cap
- Blend the ingredient to get Dream Cap Mush
book_chem_p2_s2_body:
- Take the container from the previous step
- Insert it into the Heating Plate
- Add solvent (Alcohol) equal to 3-6 time the volume of Dream Cap Mush
- Heat the mixure to 40-60C to turn Dream Cap Mush into Dream Cap Extract
book_chem_p2_s2_note: Do not overheat or Dream Cap will be destroyed
book_chem_p2_s3_body:
- (Optional) Filter the solution from the previous step with a Kotton Fabric as filter to remove large sized contaminants
- Insert the container into the Evaporator
- Make sure the Evaporator is powered with a Energy Cell
- Wait until the next day for the Evaporator to work
book_chem_p2_s4_body:
- (REQUIRED) When all the water and alcohol has evaporated, insert the container into the Chem Finisher
- Select Dream Dust as the recipe
- Press the "Output" button 
- (Optional) Check purity with a Composition Spectrometer
book_chem_p3_s1_body:
- Attach a liquid container to the Blender
- Add a few Coffee Beans
- Blend the ingredient to get Coffee Beans Mush
book_chem_p3_s2_body:
- Take the container from the previous step
- Insert it into the Heating Plate
- (Optional but Recommanded) Add solvent (Alcohol) equal to 3-6 time the volume of Coffee Bean Mush
- Heat the mixure to a minimum of 80C
book_chem_p3_s2_note: Note: Caffeine is very heat resistance
book_chem_p3_s3_body:
- (Optional) Filter the solution from the previous step with a Kotton Fabric as filter to remove large sized contaminants
- Insert the container into the Evaporator
- Make sure the Evaporator is powered with a Energy Cell
- Wait until the next day for the Evaporator to work
book_chem_p3_s4_body:
- (REQUIRED) When all the water and alcohol has evaporated, insert the container into the Chem Finisher
- Select Caffeine Pill as the recipe
- Press the "Output" button 
- (Optional) Check purity with a Composition Spectrometer
book_chem_p4_body: The precise recipe for Phanta remains a closely guarded secret. What follows is a compilation of publicly available information.
book_chem_p4_s1_body: N-Methylol Base is a known precursor of Phanta. It can be found in Restricted Chemical Supplies
book_chem_p4_s2_body: The N-Methylol Base will contain a Stabilizing Agent to protect the chemical from degradation but also prevent chemical reaction. It must be somehow removed.
book_chem_p4_s3_body:
We now need a substance that can donate electrons to the N-Methylol Base to transform it chemically into Phanta. 

We suspect this process must also be done at high temperature requiring an upgraded Heating Plate
book_chem_p4_s4_body: After that, filter the solution and package it as usual.
book_chem_p5_body: Some customers will carry Chem Scanner to verify the labeled purity of your products.
book_ingot_s1_body: Metal Ingots can be smelted inside a Furnace using TWO pieces of either Scrap Metal or Metal Ore. They can have various levels of purity. The higher the purity, the more valuable the ingot will be.
book_ingot_s2_body:
The purity of an ingot is determined by the materials used to smelt it. Using Scrap Metals will yield a lower purity, while using Metal Ores will yield a higher one. Additionally, Flux Agent can be added to the furnace to improve the purity, Any added agent will be consumed.

The Furnace requires a source of power. The smelting process happens overnight.

intel_mentor_note_shotgun_body: The Augs are humans overtaken by a rogue AI inside a brain implant. Their bodies are no longer their own, and there is currently no safe way to remove the implant without killing the host. Augs are hostile and extremely dangerous, actively seeking to kidnap people and install more Augmentation implants. Shopkeepers are the first line of defense, since Augs rely on raw materials to fabricate new implants and medical supplies to surgically implant more victims. They haven't fully mastered normal human behavior and may also use overly formal phrasing or robotic vocabulary. Shoot only if you are absolutely certain. Do not try to call Security, the Augs have hacked their comms and will flee before Security arrives.
book_water_s1_warning: WARNING: IF CONSUMED GUTTERFLOW, SEEK IMMEDIATE MEDICAL ATTENTION
commissary_lottery_redeem_notice: Redeem all winning lottery tickets into Credits (Not Commissary Tokens)
ui_clientele_tooltip: Customers will appear depending on the conditions of the Store when the Shutter Door is opened.
ui_clientele_normal_tooltip: The condition of your store will attract a number of random customers each day. Certain special items stored in the Display Case can influence which customers appear. Each of the following customers can appear once per day. Remaining slots will be filled with random customers.
ui_clientele_merch_tooltip: Most merchandise stored inside the Display Case will attract buyers. Buyers' budget depend on the value of the stored merchandise.
ui_clientele_no_merch_detected: No merchandise detected inside the display case.
ui_info_variety: This customer will only buy each item once, but will pay a premium.
ui_info_no_contraband: This customer will not accept any contraband.
ui_info_security_team: This customer is part of Station Security. Showing them Stolen or Contraband items may have consequences.
ui_info_service_power: Keeps the store lit and grid devices running. If unpaid, only Machines that run on Energy Cells will function. Lights inside the store will dim.
ui_info_service_insurance: If paid, any items stolen during the night will be returned to you the next morning.
ui_info_service_janitorial: If paid, the trash can will be emptied and the storefront will be cleaned. If the storefront is left unclean for multiple days, the store's attractiveness will decrease. If the store is currently vandalized, the cleaning cost will be higher.
ui_info_store_attractiveness: Store Attractiveness is affected by how recently the Janitor cleaned the storefront, and by certain machines and upgrades.
ui_info_reputation: Reputation with a faction can be gained by trading with their members. Trading with special customers grants increased reputation. Reporting a customer to Security may result in lost reputation with their faction.
ui_info_labeler: Certain items can have labels, which can be edited. Use this to label items honestly, or to mislabel them and sell at a higher price. Beware: different customers are better or worse at spotting mislabeled goods. If you are caught selling an item worth less than its label, your reputation may take a hit.
ui_info_inspection_genuine_claim: The customer claims this item is genuine and in working condition. Use this panel to confront them if you find any sign that it's counterfeit or broken. One issue is enough. If you are wrong, your reputation may take a hit.
ui_info_inspection_counterfeit_claim: The customer is selling this item and claims it's counterfeit or broken. If you believe they're wrong, use this panel to say so. They will raise their asking price accordingly and grant you reputation.

book_hand_intro: Cybernetic hands vary widely on the Station, and so do their prices. This guide will help determine the fair market value of any cybernetic hand.
book_hand_p1_s1_body: All cybernetic hands start at 100 Credits. Various conditions can affect their price. Regardless of condition, the minimum value of a cybernetic hand is 50 Credits.
book_hand_p3_s1_body: Add-ons bonus are independent and each can apply.
book_hand_p3_s2_body: Specific combinations of cybernetic hands can increase their value.
book_hand_p3_s2_body2:
Tactical:
- Carbon Composite
- EMG+ or Neural Interface
- No wear or damage
- Armored and blade
book_hand_p3_s2_body3:
Deluxe:
- Gold Plated
- Neural Interface
- No wear or damage
- With or without any add-ons

book_wine_p2_body1: Water quality affects wine quality. Use High Quality Water or Basewater. Pure Water lacks the minerals needed for fermentation. Lower grades of water will greatly reduce wine quality.
book_wine_p2_body2: Standard yeast is optional but highly recommended. Without it, wild yeast from the air will ferment the wine instead, producing inconsistent results. Standard yeast also greatly accelerates fermentation.
book_wine_p2_body3: Berry quality is the most important factor. One handful is enough for lower-grade wine. Two handfuls are necessary for high-grade wine. Avoid overripe, underripe, or moldy berries. The best berries for winemaking are usually smaller than normal.
